title: Ricky Rat
description: Two rats race through a generated maze, using the original 1982 BASIC algorithms.
versionOrder: Inferred from source changes and within-side save order. All complete saves are on tape18b; saves 2 and 3 repeat the first form. Saves 15 and 19 are damaged and remain separate. Import v15 is recovery-label V14, save 18, the latest complete form. The later damaged V15 is not substituted or repaired.
